question: Noted dancer Birju Maharaj bagged the Filmfare award for best Choreographer for which film in 2016?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bajirao Mastani.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Birju Maharaj won the Filmfare award for best Choreographer for the film "Bajirao Mastani" in 2016.**
 
• "Bajirao Mastani" is a period drama film directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali and features Ranveer S
